sources.name: Ruten Taiwan used POS search
sources.observation: Used Flytech POS462 touchscreen POS listed at NT$1,000 with power-on response and local inspection invited.
sources.limitations: Search/listing observation only; exact B91 motherboard revision, available quantity, functional yield and seller continuity are unverified.

sources.name: Flytech POS460 Series user manual — B91 specification
sources.observation: B91-family POS462 documentation specifies 12.1-inch resistive touch, SATA storage, up to 4 GB DDR2, 10/100/1000 LAN, four powered COM ports, six external USB ports and Linux OS support.
sources.limitations: Model-family documentation; the exact physical donor must be inspected to establish B91 identity and installed options.

sources.name: Flytech POS460 Series user manual mirror
sources.observation: Revision history documents B91 addition and storage changes; also documents multiple POS462 panel variants and service details.
sources.limitations: Historical service documentation does not prove condition or compatibility of a particular used unit.
